### How gates are judged

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    G(["a gate"]) --> Q{"type?"}
    Q -->|prevention| P["fires=0 is healthy · value = liveness (probe) · keep unless the guarded risk is gone"]
    Q -->|detection| D["value = firing history · long cold + costly ⇒ removal-candidate (human ②uniqueness)"]
    Q -->|advisory| V["does not block · value: is the signal consumed? · human decides"]
    Q -->|untyped| U["classify it: add a gatecrate-type marker (or register a reject injector)"]
    Q -->|not-a-gate| X["harness tooling · excluded from ROI"]
```
